name: araf-protocol
description: Araf Protocol monorepo: setup, lint, build and test runner for contracts, backend and frontend (Node 22)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix contracts ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run init:env
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix contracts run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:abi-drift
